SensorGroupColorEvent.why: The shipped table and eventwalk.py both give this fifty-eight nodes and both read 111 bits where a session carries 133.  Its colours are not a counted list: it sends a thirty-two bit mask and then an entry for each bit standing in it, each of those being a flag and, if set, four bytes of colour.  No op could say that until OpCountBits, which keeps a mask's population count.  Measured on a spawned session: the mask came back all ones with two colours carried, 5 + 32 + 32 + 2*32 = 133.  Cross-checked against t2-demo-parser (MIT, github.com/exogen/t2-demo-parser).
